title: 确定性 Wiki 诊断展开
scope: Deterministic bounded model-free diagnostic expansion over Wiki Markdown relations; unit-level only, no real extracted Wiki content, no HTTP/SDK wiring

design: Relations are read only from schema-declared frontmatter reference fields (ref_kind, reference_key); no semantic/inferred edges
BFS with visited-set (no cycles) + max_depth + max_nodes caps; truncation reported explicitly
Configured path: canonical Symptom -> configuration anchor (ConfigSpec/Device) -> matched Profile -> ordered possible_faults -> affected_components
Generic path: Symptom.asserted_faults -> Fault -> affected_components, reported separately with path='generic' and labelled as a configuration-free source assertion

Profile is matched only by exact anchor equality (config_spec_uri or device_uri); anchor present but no matching profile -> applicability 'undetermined' (or 'not_applicable' only on explicit caller determination)
Missing/unreadable link target -> 'missing_edge:<field>:<uri>' gap; no edge fabricated
Target outside namespace_root -> 'outside_namespace:<uri>' gap; traversal never crosses the namespace
Fuzzy symptom normalization delegated to injected normalize callable (unified hybrid search); candidates filtered to in-namespace Symptom; no second retriever introduced

TC-10.11: test_profile_and_generic_evidence_are_reported_separately: expansion runs with no model call and yields exact configured chain plus separate generic evidence
test_unknown_configuration_is_undetermined_and_generic_is_evidence_only: unknown configuration -> 'undetermined' + unknown=('configuration',), generic stays evidence only
test_missing_edge_does_not_fabricate_a_relationship: dangling asserted_faults target -> missing_edge gap, no invented node
TC-10.16: test_generic_assertion_never_overrides_inapplicable_profile: explicit not_applicable is not overridden by a generic assertion; configured path stays empty
test_no_cross_namespace_traversal: out-of-namespace edge never traversed, recorded as outside_namespace gap
test_fuzzy_normalization_uses_injected_unified_search_only: only the injected callable is used and only in-namespace Symptom candidates are returned

NOT_RUN: Real end-to-end Wiki build over VikingFS with real extracted SANY entities (no production Wiki content available in this environment)
Human gold diagnostic cases / independent adjudication of diagnostic paths
HTTP/SDK wiring for POST /api/v1/kb/wiki/traverse (F10.8 API surface not implemented here)
Interaction with real registered schema package hashes, catalog capability states and source authorization receipts
Full F10 / M3 gate acceptance; feature_acceptance remains NOT_RUN
